slides.title: Scary stories for cleaning company owners
slides.body: read these with the lights on

slides.label: Story 1
slides.title: The office building wants your COI by Friday.
slides.body: The one on file expired... last month.

slides.label: Story 2
slides.title: The renewal notice went to an email nobody checks.
slides.body: It's been sitting there since August.

slides.label: Story 4
slides.title: New client contract: "proof of workers' comp required."
slides.body: You think it renewed. You're pretty sure.

slides.label: The happy ending
slides.title: COI, bond, business license, workers' comp.
slides.body: Four dates. Write them down somewhere you'll actually see. Save this before the next walkthrough.
